notes: Anatomical surface regions for Character Surface Integration (character_modeling.surface_integration). Located by spatial query in the rig's frame: a band along a bone (span: 0 = the bone's head, 1 = its tail; beyond extends it) and a sector of azimuth from the front round the vertical axis through the axis bone's head (0..180, symmetric). The first region that contains a point names it. No vertex indices: the same regions serve every physique, topology and component on this rig.
